result.rationale: The migration (db/migrate/20150818190757_create_embeddable_hosts.rb) creates embeddable_hosts with no index on host, and the new EmbeddableHost.record_for_host queries `where("lower(host) = ?", host)`. This lookup is called in ensure_embeddable (embed_controller) on every embed request and in TopicEmbed.import, making it a hot-path unindexed full scan. A real, specific performance concern grounded in the diff, though not incorrect behavior.
